title: Take apart bundling fix: make the served client and model independent of the Worker bundler

Loopback to builder: R1 holds. src/take-apart-client.js and src/take-apart-model-browser.js now export literal template-string source, and no served byte comes from toString(). The model still gets FACTS as JSON data.; R2 holds. The '/vendor/three.module.min.js' specifier is unchanged and now sits inside a string the bundler cannot resolve. browser-pass.log shows the route answering 200 with 670681 decoded bytes. src/index.js and the vendor route are untouched.; R3 holds. The diff touches only the two serving modules, the capture script and .gitignore, and the only text changes are template escapes. The parity tests are retained.; R4/S1 hold. bundle-build.log records `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir` with exit status 0 and no patches.; R5/S2/S3 hold. browser-pass.log shows 0 console errors, 0 page errors, TakeApartModel as an object, scene ready true, and canvas 1022x559 matching its layout. beat-assembled.png shows the rendered patch in the scene region.; R6 holds. The capture script builds with wrangler and serves the output with `wrangler dev --no-bundle`. It no longer imports src/index.js. The evidence README names it as the evidence of record.; R7/S4: I re-ran npm test and got 161 pass, 1 fail, 1 skip. The failure is design-v4-square-product S11, which reads the wo-gh-8 reviewer-design output. It is itemized by name, but the inputs don't show it resolved on a sibling branch. The operator or verdict station should confirm that. No other run's evidence was edited.; S5 can't be checked from these inputs. The builder model (gpt-6-astra) and the five counted reviews are run-report facts.; I did not re-run wrangler or the browser pass. I only read the logs and screenshot and re-ran the Node suite. The review file is at runs/wo-gh-11/reviewer-spec.output.md.; The served client and model are now static template literals. The only interpolation is JSON.stringify of the static FACTS.layers, so no request-derived data reaches the served JS and there is no injection path.; The one nested template literal in src/take-apart-client.js (line 144) is correctly escaped. The literals contain no other backslashes or `${`, so the served code keeps its previous behavior.; The change adds no routes, dependencies, headers or secrets. The .gitignore change only un-ignores evidence/take-apart-bundling/*.log.; scripts/capture-take-apart.mjs binds only to 127.0.0.1 and starts wrangler with an argument array, so no shell is involved. It removes its temp build directory afterwards. WRANGLER_BIN, PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE and CHROME_BIN come from the operator's environment. Chrome runs with --no-sandbox, which is acceptable on the CI runner only.; Non-blocking: the served JS routes have no CSP or nosniff headers. That is unchanged from before this work order. The review is saved at runs/wo-gh-11/reviewer-security.output.md.; The tests are real. tests/take-apart-bundling.test.js has 16 tests, and all 16 pass on the final tree. With the builder diff stashed, bundling R1 (no toString), R2 (no static vendor import) and R6 (evidence of record capture) fail. So the tests catch the F1, F4 and F5 defects.; The tests map to the spec. R1 is covered by scans for toString, bundler helper names and renamed collisions, plus vm execution of the served model and client. R2 and S3 are covered by the vendor specifier scan, the route reference, and the 670681-byte and sha256 check. R3 and S4 are covered by route shapes, the sampled model parity comparison and the main page link. R4/S1 and R5/S2/S3 are covered by the committed logs. R6 is covered by the capture script headers. S5 is correctly left as a run report fact.; The screenshot test decodes the committed PNGs and checks tone variety in the central region, so it does not rely on the log alone. Reviewer-design still has to judge that the patch is visible.; Limit: the R4 and R5 tests only match text in the committed logs, because wrangler and a browser are not repo dependencies. A hand-written log would pass them. The logs agree with the capture script: `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir` exit 0, 0 console errors, 0 page errors, scene ready true, canvas 1022x559 matching its layout, vendor 200 with 670681 bytes. I did not re-run wrangler or the browser.; Full suite: `npm test` gives 161 pass, 1 fail, 1 skip. The failure is 'S11: when reviewer-design has reviewed, it addresses and clears all four images against design/reference/' in tests/design-v4-square-product.test.js. It also fails on the baseline without this change. It is itemized by name in evidence/take-apart-bundling/README.md. I could not confirm that a sibling branch resolves it (R7), so the operator or verdict station should confirm. The skip is ui-elevation S4, which has no main ref. No other run's evidence was edited.; Minor, not blocking: the 'no local patch' check is a text match on the log, and the production-origin guard only scans src/.; The review file is at runs/wo-gh-11/reviewer-architecture.output.md. brain/decisions/ does not exist and brain/project.md records no decisions, so I checked fit only against the spec and the existing structure.; R1: src/take-apart-client.js and src/take-apart-model-browser.js now export literal template-string source, and no served path calls toString(). The only interpolation is JSON.stringify(FACTS.layers), which is data. The exported names and the lazy imports at src/index.js:78-83 are unchanged.; R2/R3: the three.js dynamic import now sits inside a string, so esbuild cannot resolve it. The /vendor route and the vendored bytes are untouched. package.json, wrangler.toml and src/index.js are unchanged, and no site dependency was added. Playwright and wrangler stay runner-installed.; R4/R5/R6: scripts/capture-take-apart.mjs now runs `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir`, then serves the built output with `wrangler dev --no-bundle`. It no longer imports src/index.js. The committed logs show exit 0, zero console errors, zero page errors, TakeApartModel defined, scene ready true, a 1022x559 canvas matching its layout, and a vendor response of 200 with 670681 bytes.; R3: I ran tests/take-apart-bundling.test.js and tests/take-apart.test.js myself, and all 39 pass. The model parity tests are still in place.; R7: the one full-suite failure is S11 in tests/design-v4-square-product.test.js:482, which reads the existing wo-gh-8 reviewer-design output. This change does not touch it, and the builder itemized it by name. That a sibling branch resolves it is not verifiable from these inputs, so the operator should confirm it.; Non-blocking: the direct-import capture was replaced rather than kept as a second surface. R6 allows either, and the older evidence in evidence/take-apart/ is untouched.; Non-blocking: there is no repo-level syntax check on the literal source, so a syntax error would surface only in the browser pass or in the bundling test.; Bundled-browser screenshots show the rendered patch across all five tour states. The interface preserves the documented palette and existing composition; the source diff leaves page styling and behavior unchanged. browser-pass.log records zero console errors, zero page errors, and scene ready=true.; R7 remains unmet: evidence/take-apart-bundling/test-suite.log records one failure, 'S11: when reviewer-design has reviewed, it addresses and clears all four images against design/reference/'. The evidence README explicitly says sibling-branch resolution is not established. Provide a passing suite or establish the permitted sibling-resolution exception without modifying another run's evidence.
